plan.title: gate(agents-md): advisory absolute always-on budget (<=8 KB / ~2k tok)

narratives.Description: Wire the absolute half of the layered budget instrument locked on #2372 as advisory/report-only. Keep the relative line-count ratchet fail-closed. Do not fail-close the absolute ceiling in this story.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1) Inspect packages/core/src/policy/agents-md-budget.ts and packages/cli/src/verify-agents-md-budget.ts for the relative line-count ratchet. 2) Add an absolute managed-section byte/token measurement (target <=8192 bytes / ~2000 tok) that emits advisory output without changing the fail-closed relative ratchet exit. 3) Extend packages/core/src/policy/agents-md-budget.test.ts with over-budget advisory and under-budget quiet cases using fixtures. 4) Verify with: pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src/policy/agents-md-budget.test.ts and a manual task verify:agents-md-budget run showing advisory text. 5) CHANGELOG [Unreleased] note for layered advisory absolute budget; DD-3 frontmatter noted as deferred to #2452/#2370.
narratives.UserStory: As a framework maintainer, I want an advisory absolute always-on budget meter, so that Wave 2 relocation has a measurable north-star without blocking Wave 1 merges.
narratives.Origin: Enriched for swarm launch from GitHub issue #2450 under epic #2369

narrative.Acceptance: Given the current managed section (~29KB), when the advisory meter runs, then it reports over-budget without failing task check by default.
Given plan.policy.agentsMdBudget line caps, when verify:agents-md-budget runs in fail-closed mode, then growth still fails as today.
Given CHANGELOG/docs touch, when read, then advisory-now vs promote-later (#2452) is explicit.
